title: Ronald Reagan and Gorbachev: 'Tear Down This Wall!'
summary: Freedom cannot be contained by concrete walls; open the gates to human liberty.

full_text:
Historical Exchange featuring Mikhail Gorbachev & Ronald Reagan.

"Freedom cannot be contained by concrete walls; open the gates to human liberty."

This celebrated moment in parliamentary and diplomatic history illustrates the timeless power of intellect, courage, and rhetorical brilliance.
